fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on high electricity costs and alleged monopolistic practices of Florida Power & Light; criticism of Miami city budget cuts affecting police and inspectors; discussion of Dade County road construction controversies (including the Key Largo road); coverage of Coast Guard cutter 248 and liquor seizure allegations; and a detailed critique of the City of Miami’s bus agreement with the Miami Beach Railway Company. Includes letters to the editor, satire columns, and local advertisements.
